title: Prove the sharp five-term asymmetric C5 decoder cost
body:
## Summary

```text
five asymmetric terms fitting the strict C5 mask
  -> five source edge lines and their dual basis
  -> an adjacent full plane pair on both sides of every term
  -> each binary pairing tariff >= 4; total cost >= 20
```

Closes the minimum-term part of PR3232's unequal-factor handoff. Every exact five-term fit on the 23 physical C5s costs at least 20 with arbitrary rational, real or complex coefficients and ordinary transpose. Cost 20 is attained. The scalar minimum of five is already PR2484's result; the new step classifies its equality case and transfers it to the full-plane tariff.

This does not bound arbitrary asymmetric decompositions with six or more terms. A literal six-term cost 20 fit has term prices `2,4,4,4,4,2`, so the individual-charge conclusion fails beyond the stated hypothesis. No native implementation, global cost 224 floor, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3232 proves the arbitrary-term Gram floor but its block-cover inequality fails for unequal source/target spans.
- After: a written dimension and dual-basis proof covers every five-term asymmetric factorization. Source-bound replay checks all 23 physical cycles, exact attaining and unequal-support fits, and the six-term boundary.
- Registered standard-library CPython 3.12.15 replay passed: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/c5-rank-tight-asymmetric`. All 11 control groups pass, including a separately enumerated cycle census, all 23552 rectangular tariff comparisons by dense binary elimination, rational duality and source/tariff/strict-mask rejection controls.
- A separate worker's read-only proof review found no blocker and independently passed both scripts on Python 3.12.15. This is internal review, not independent human or formal-kernel verification.
- Metadata/source pins, Ruff `E,F,B,I,UP,C4,SIM`, formatting, and `git diff --check` pass. All 9 committed package/input byte comparisons and archive integrity pass at `96e3ccd00c62f73d30a23f8d774eea59bfe3b97c`.
- Exact committed Git-free read-only export passes both direct scripts with `-OO -B -W error` under CPython 3.13.16. Hosted CI, Lean, Docker and selected cold replay were not run.

Package: `research/c5-rank-tight-asymmetric/`, with source pins, exact receipts, reproduction, scope metadata and Open next questions. Card `coverage-law-change`, explicit change to this local decoder obstruction, priority revision 6. Canonical main refreshed unchanged at `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`; submission snapshot covers 289 open PRs and 2,069 Discussion records with complete pagination. Closed work and omitted local packages are not exhaustively searched.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19003021). Credit thakrarsagar/PR3232 and PR2484, Tekalign/PR2782, Arham Tahir/PR2879, Cinna Davis/PR1825, Adam Gall/PR1889, ctoth, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained E8/P112 lineage. PR3232 is pinned at `9d75ed2b5bc9bb8cb19f205724f978b02be732cb`; its source package is unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One isolated package. Selected records, shared tools, frozen geometry and predecessor packages are unchanged.
